Name: Gedor, Son of Jehiel
Summary: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:31; 1 Chronicles 9:37: Son of Jehiel the father of Gibeon.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Gedor stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
